name: @w6w-apps/insightly
description: Manage Insightly contacts, organisations, opportunities and leads.

w6w.longDescription:
Insightly is a CRM built around four core objects — Contacts, Organisations, Opportunities and Leads — and this app puts full create/read/update/delete on each of them behind a workflow.

Contacts and Organisations are the address book: create and edit either one, look a record up by ID, list or filter the collection by any field, and delete a record when it is no longer wanted. Opportunities carry a deal through Insightly's pipeline — name, stage, bid amount and currency, forecast and actual close dates, the responsible user — and Leads carry a prospect before it becomes a Contact, with its own source and status.

Every list action doubles as a search: leave the filter empty for a plain paginated listing, or set a field name and value to use Insightly's field-level Search endpoint instead — including a search by custom field, and a filter on when a record was last updated.

Insightly is multi-tenant across regional "pods" (na1, eu1, ...) rather than one shared host, so the pod is part of the Connection, alongside the per-user API key found in the Insightly web app's own User Settings.

Out of scope for now: file attachments, tags, links between records, projects, tasks, custom objects, and the pipeline/stage/pricebook administrative endpoints — all real Insightly API surfaces, left out to keep this app to the four objects a CRM workflow touches most.
